attchmntText: Lokesh Machines Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Lokesh Machines Limited confirms no deviation or variation in the utilization of proceeds from its preferential issue of equity shares and convertible warrants for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The funds were raised on May 6, 2026, with an amount of 7409.99. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement and noted that the Share Allotment Committee converted 5,00,000 warrants into equity shares for non-promoters, receiving listing and trading approvals from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. This conversion increased the paid-up equity share capital to 2,17,96,770 equity shares. As of November 12, 2026, 22,77,919 warrants remain pending for conversion. The company submitted the statement in XBRL mode alongside its financial statements. The declaration was signed by Managing Director Mullapudi Lokeswara Rao and Chief Financial Officer Valmeti Sudhakara Reddy.

attchmntText: Lokesh Machines Limited has informed the Exchange about the change in KMP for the purpose of determining materiality of an event or information.
voiceSummary: Lokesh Machines Limited has designated Key Managerial Personnel to determine the materiality of events and make disclosures under SEBI Listing Regulations. The Board of Directors made this designation during a meeting held on November 12, 2026. The appointed personnel are Mullapudi Lokeswara Rao, serving as Managing Director with DIN 00989447; V. Sudhakara Reddy, Chief Financial Officer; C. Venkatanna, General Manager, Personnel and Industrial Relations; and Mohit Yadav, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. Contact details provided include the email cosecy@lokeshmachines.com and phone numbers 040-23079310 and 040-23079311. This information is submitted for the records of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

attchmntText: Lokesh Machines Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Lokesh Machines Limited announced changes in its leadership following a Board meeting on November 12, 2026. The Board recommended the re-designation of Mr. Mullapudi Lokeswara Rao, DIN 00989447, from Managing Director to Whole-Time Director. This recommendation is subject to shareholder approval via Postal Ballot for a three-year term from December 21, 2026, to December 20, 2029. The Board also recommended the re-designation and appointment of Mr. Srinivas Mullapudi, DIN 00917565, from Whole-Time Director to Managing Director. This appointment is also subject to shareholder approval via Postal Ballot for a three-year term from December 21, 2026, to December 20, 2029. The Board took note of the resignation of Mr. Pusuluru Kodanda Rami Reddy as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective October 10, 2026. Mr. Mohit Yadav was appointed as the new Company Secretary, Compliance Officer, and Key Managerial Personnel, effective November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Lokesh Machines Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Lokesh Machines Limited reported a net profit of 130.64 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 231.65 lakhs for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results and noted the resignation of Mr. Pusuluru Kodanda Rami Reddy as Company Secretary. Mr. Mohit Yadav was appointed as the new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. Mr. Mullapudi Lokeswara Rao was re-designated as Whole-Time Director, while Mr. Srinivas Mullapudi was appointed as Managing Director. The company converted 5,00,000 warrants into equity shares, increasing paid-up capital to 2,179.68 lakhs. A postal ballot is placed for shareholder approval, with Mr. L.D. Reddy appointed as Scrutinizer and the cut-off date set for November 13, 2026. The company confirmed its removal from the OFAC SDN List on June 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Lokesh Machines Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Lokesh Machines Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Net profit for the quarter was Rs. 130.64 lakhs, compared to Rs. 62.62 lakhs in the same period last year. Half-year net profit stood at Rs. 231.65 lakhs versus Rs. 108.17 lakhs previously. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 6,037.06 lakhs. The company converted 5,00,000 warrants into equity shares, increasing paid-up capital to 2,179.68 lakhs. Twenty-two lakh seventy-seven thousand nine hundred nineteen warrants remain pending conversion. The US Treasury removed the company from the OFAC SDN List on June 30, 2026, allowing resumption of foreign currency transactions. Statutory auditors issued an unmodified limited review report.
